name: Bina
title: Asher's wife
summary: Bina (also spelled Binjah) is mentioned in Genesis 46:17 as one of Asher's descendants who went down to Egypt with Jacob and his family. She is traditionally regarded as Asher's daughter, though some traditions identify her as a female relative associated with the tribe of Asher. She is part of the list of Jacob's household that settled in Egypt.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Bina is mentioned among Asher's children who went down to Egypt with Jacob and his entire household.

keyEvents.title: Listing of Jacob's descendants
keyEvents.description: In the listing of all of Jacob's descendants who came to Egypt, Bina is mentioned as part of Asher's family, among the seventy persons belonging to Jacob's house.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy of Asher in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Bina is mentioned again in the record of Asher's descendants as part of the tribe's genealogy.

keyEvents.title: The Census in Numbers
keyEvents.description: Asher's tribe, to which Bina belonged, was counted among the tribes of Israel in the wilderness. The tribe's descendants made up a significant portion of the people.
